lines.text: Do you take the bus to work?
lines.speaker: Fay

lines.text: Usually, yes. But I walk on Fridays.
lines.speaker: Ren

lines.text: Why do you walk on Fridays?
lines.speaker: Fay

lines.text: Because I have more time on Fridays.
lines.speaker: Ren

lines.text: I walk through the park because it's quiet.
lines.speaker: Ren

lines.text: I prefer the main road. There's a bakery I like.
lines.speaker: Fay

lines.text: Oh, I know that bakery. The bread is good.
lines.speaker: Ren
